entries.457b96fc96b0842c: This is the segment of T&D United Capital Co., Ltd. and its consolidated subsidiaries, an investment subsidiary that invests in business areas closely related to the life insurance business. Aiming to diversify and optimize the group's business portfolio, it is working to establish and strengthen its profit center function through strategic business investments in new growth areas. Its main investments are in the closed-book business. Following FGH Parent, L.P. in the United States (Fortitude; voting rights 26.4%; equity-method affiliate), in August 2025 it acquired an interest in Viridium Group GmbH & Co. KG (Viridium; voting rights 29.9%; equity-method affiliate), a German life insurance holding company. Three of the group's life insurance companies cede part of their policy reserves to Fortitude as reinsurance. Ordinary revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,218 million (¥1,879 million in the prior year), the smallest of the four reportable segments. The net loss attributable to owners of the parent was ¥2.1 billion, a decrease of ¥0.5 billion from ¥2.7 billion in the prior year. Number of employees was 18 (as of March 31, 2026).

entries.9006d78be6018ce7: This is the business of T&D Financial Life Insurance Company, a life insurance company whose sales market is the shared agency market, selling insurance products through shared agencies such as financial institutions. Since June 2025, in collaboration with asset management companies, it has started new services that combine systematic investment and insurance, "Tsumi-eru" and "THEO Tsumitate Anshin Hoken". In February 2026 it launched the variable individual annuity insurance "Secure Flight", which guarantees a minimum of 100% of the annuity principal. Ordinary revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥912,827 million (¥959,073 million in the prior year), the third largest of the four reportable segments, and insurance premiums and other income was ¥784,664 million (¥921,711 million in the prior year). The company cites a decrease in reinsurance income, among other factors, as the reason for the decline in insurance premiums and other income. T&D Financial Life Insurance Company's net income for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥8,221 million, and its number of employees was 331 (as of March 31, 2026).

entries.ceea453e87307caf: An insurance holding company with three subsidiaries, Taiyo Life, Daido Life, and T&D Financial Life, engaged mainly in the life insurance business.
entries.dcd43f812691b861: This is the business of Taiyo Life Insurance Company, a life insurance company whose sales market is the household market. It mainly handles individual life insurance and individual annuity insurance, and also handles group insurance and group annuity insurance. The company explains that the Himawari Dementia Prevention Insurance is supported mainly by senior customers, and that the Cancer and Critical Illness Prevention Insurance is supported across a wide range of age groups, including the core working-age generation. In August 2025 it launched Taiyo Life's Savings Insurance, and in December 2025 it launched Insurance Suite BestMYWAY Pre-existing Condition Relaxation Plus. Ordinary revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,275,387 million, the largest of the four reportable segments, and insurance premiums and other income was ¥983,087 million (¥805,591 million in the prior year). Ordinary revenue decreased from ¥1,712,800 million in the prior year. The company attributes this mainly to the reversal of the increase in policy reserve reversals associated with reinsurance transactions for the in-force block of its Lifetime Dementia and Long-Term Care Annuity Insurance in the prior year. Taiyo Life Insurance Company's net income for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥52,262 million, and its number of employees was 12,433 (as of March 31, 2026).
